Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.security

Class UserGroupManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.security.UserGroupManager
public class UserGroupManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Security User/Group REST API client.

Manages users, groups, and their memberships in the active or a named user/group service.

Source: src/restconfig/src/main/java/org/geoserver/rest/security/UsersRestController.java
@RequestMapping("/security/usergroup")

Endpoints covered


 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/users
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/groups
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/group/{group}/users
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/user/{user}/groups
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/users
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/user/{user}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/user/{user}
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/group/{group}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/group/{group}
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/user/{user}/group/{group}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/user/{user}/group/{group}
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/users
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/groups
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/group/{group}/users
 GET    /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/user/{user}/groups
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/users
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/user/{user}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/user/{user}
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/group/{group}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/group/{group}
 POST   /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/user/{user}/group/{group}
 DELETE /rest/security/usergroup/service/{service}/user/{user}/group/{group}

Usage example


 UserGroupManager mgr = client.userGroup();
 mgr.createUser("alice", "P@ssw0rd!", true);
 mgr.createGroup("editors");
 mgr.assignUserToGroup("alice", "editors");

    • getUsers

      public List<SecurityUserInfo> getUsers()
      Returns all users in the active user/group service. The password field is always null in the response.
      Returns:
      list of user info (never null; empty when none exist)

    • getGroups

      public List<String> getGroups()
      Returns all group names in the active user/group service.
      Returns:
      list of group names (never null; empty when none exist)

    • getGroupUsers

      public List<SecurityUserInfo> getGroupUsers(String group)
      Returns users belonging to a group in the active user/group service. Unlike the Roles API, throws 404 for a non-existent group.
      Parameters:
      group - group name (required)
      Returns:
      list of user info (never null; empty when none assigned)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if group does not exist (404)

    • getUserGroups

      public List<String> getUserGroups(String user)
      Returns the groups a user belongs to in the active user/group service. Throws 404 for a non-existent user.
      Parameters:
      user - user name (required)
      Returns:
      list of group names (never null; empty when none assigned)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if user does not exist (404)

    • createUser

      public void createUser(String userName, String password, boolean enabled)
      Creates a new user in the active user/group service. Request body is wrapped as {"user":{...}} — flat JSON causes 500. Password policy requires upper/lower/digit/special characters.
      Parameters:
      userName - user name (required)
      password - password meeting the server's complexity requirements (required)
      enabled - whether the user is enabled on creation

    • updateUser

      public void updateUser(String userName, String password, Boolean enabled)
      Updates an existing user in the active user/group service. Pass null for any parameter to leave it unchanged.
      Parameters:
      userName - user name of the user to update (required)
      password - new password, or null to leave unchanged
      enabled - new enabled state, or null to leave unchanged

    • deleteUser

      public void deleteUser(String user)
      Deletes a user from the active user/group service.
      Parameters:
      user - user name to delete (required)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if user does not exist (404)

    • createGroup

      public void createGroup(String group)
      Creates a new group in the active user/group service (no body required). Throws on duplicate — GeoServer returns 404 for name conflicts.
      Parameters:
      group - group name to create (required)

      public void assignUserToGroup(String user, String group)
      Assigns a user to a group in the active user/group service. Duplicate assignments are idempotent (returns 200).

      group - group name to assign the user to (required)
